title: Legacy Charges / Sources payment flow removed
summary: Creating charges directly with card/source tokens (Charges API + Sources) is no longer supported. The PaymentIntents API is the only supported integration path.
body: Charges.create with source, and the SetSource parameter helpers in the Go SDK, were removed in the current major SDK lines. Use PaymentIntent confirm flows instead.

operations.detail: replaced by payment_method / confirm PaymentIntent flow

migration: Migrate from Charges to PaymentIntents: 1) create a PaymentIntent server-side, 2) collect card details with Stripe.js elements, 3) confirm the payment. Replace stripe.charges.create({ source: tok }) with paymentIntents.create({ amount, currency, payment_method, confirm: true }). In Go use paymentintent.New with PaymentIntentParams and SetPaymentMethod.
